endings.title: Quiet duty
endings.body: Marcos left to warn river kin. You inherit a chair, a mug, and a log that will never be complete. HQ calls it routine. The bend remembers.

endings.title: Last fragment
endings.body: Marcos vanished chasing Condor's trail. You hold the last clean fragment of that party — and a frequency list with gaps on purpose.

endings.title: Clean channel
endings.body: The channel is clean. The town grows colder when you visit. You did the job. Marcos is deferred — not found, not forgiven.

endings.title: Soft link
endings.body: You're a link in a longer chain. More rumor than victory. Marcos may be alive in the net you helped keep quiet.

endings.title: Borrowed chair
endings.body: You survived the fortnight. The basin keeps its secrets. The chair still feels borrowed — but it's yours tonight.
